description: The slotted controller is removed by a full-set transition (activated at seq 4): the vault is retiring (§8.3). The remaining controller then revokes the writer. §8.3: hosts MUST NOT introduce epochs while the vault is retiring and a `revoke` MAY carry empty `epochs`, so the revoke is ok with `epochs: []` and no epoch 2 exists; the removed key's retiring vault therefore opens nothing made after. The kept record is admitted.
